items.text: Puka Nacua listed DOUBTFUL for Sunday; not expected to play per Rapoport, with McVay saying barring setback could return next week vs Eagles. Davante Adams expected to carry the load.
items.why: Official listing and insider reports; no practice progress.
items.implication: Adams primary target earner and red-zone option; upgrade Adams routes/targets.
items.opportunity: Adams high route/target rate without Nacua historically.

items.text: Commanders officially ruled out QB Jayden Daniels for Sunday; Marcus Mariota starts. Positive longer-term notes, not IR.
items.why: Official ruling; Rapoport notes good news longer-term.
items.implication: Mariota start; McLaurin retains some value but tough SEA matchup.
items.opportunity: McLaurin 25% target share historically with Mariota.

items.text: Texans ruled out WR Nico Collins (hamstring) for Sunday at Indianapolis.
items.why: Official team ruling confirmed by Schefter/Rapoport/ETR.
items.implication: Elevates TE Dalton Schultz target share significantly.
items.opportunity: Schultz saw 30% routes targeted and 28% target share last week without Collins.

items.text: Steelers ruled out RB Rico Dowdle (toe); Jaylen Warren questionable (shoulder) but coach says Warren will lead the group.
items.why: Official; RB coach: Warren lead, freshen with breathers.
items.implication: Warren lead back with checkdown upside vs CIN; Homer/Heidenreich backups.
items.opportunity: Warren volume spike + Rodgers checkdowns; projecting in.

items.text: Projecting Jaylen Warren (shoulder), Mike Evans (hip), Brock Bowers (knee) in despite QUESTIONABLE tags; hoping early clarity on Flowers/Moore/Mitchell.
items.why: ETR internal projections based on practice/news.
items.implication: Start them if rostered; monitor updates.

items.text: ETR Week 3 projections live; Jahmyr Gibbs set new record ceiling projection at 44.0 (avg of top 25th percentile sim outcomes).
Broncos RBs J.K. Dobbins and RJ Harvey off injury report and good to go vs Rams; Jonah Coleman OUT (ankle).
items.why: Official off IR/report; ETR lists IN.
items.implication: Committee returns; limits any Coleman buzz.

items.text: With Dowdle out, Jaylen Warren will lead Steelers RBs; vertical pass game failed for Rodgers so expect zillion checkdowns to Warren. Projecting Warren (Q) in.
items.why: Coach comments + pass game inefficiency data.

items.text: Jonathon Brooks expected IR (only 5 games career); Chuba Hubbard firmly lead role (RB14 util), AJ Dillon primary backup.
Davante Adams ran 142 routes without Nacua as Ram, targeted on 42%; prior misses: 5-35-3 and 8-195-2. Nacua doubtful boosts Adams.
items.opportunity: High TPRR and production sans Nacua.

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest RB rush yards prop (88.5); DAL 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.

Loves Chase Brown (@PIT, 20+ touches/15% targets, PIT weak vs RBs); Chris Olave (vs LV, double-digit tgts, high aDOT, LV allows 18.7 ypr); Christian Watson (vs ATL, WR8 util, 38% RZ); Dalton Schultz (@IND, 28% tgt share sans Collins, IND weak vs TE).
items.opportunity: Brown volume; Olave/Watson air yards/RZ; Schultz elevated targets.

items.text: Hates Rhamondre Stevenson (@JAX, low snaps/touches post-fumble, JAX stout vs RB); Travis Etienne (vs LV, only 49% touches/38% 3rd-down snaps even with Kamara); Terry McLaurin (vs SEA, fewest WR fantasy pts allowed, low implied total).
items.conflict: Henderson saw elevated snaps post-Stevenson fumble but Berry still ranks Stevenson ahead.

items.text: Post-Stevenson fumble, TreVeyon Henderson 65% snaps and out-touched 16-5 rest of game (gap narrowed but still ranks Stevenson ahead); Schultz 30% route targets/28% share without Collins.
items.opportunity: Henderson pass-pro limits but volume up; Schultz Colts TE-friendly.
